name: Network rack (InfiniBand leaf/spine, 48U, 800 mm)
description: Air-cooled 800 mm wide 48U network cabinet sized for 8 NVIDIA Q3400-RA 4U switches (32U) plus patch panels, cable managers and a management switch. Wide cabinet for 144-port cable management. Power and weight are typical estimates; switch ports are modeled through the switch equipment entries.

nominal_power_w.note: 8 x Q3400-RA at 2.9 kW typical (vendor, passive cables) plus ~1.6 kW optics each (72 x 1.6T twin-port modules at ~22 W typical vs 33.5 W max), plus ~0.3 kW management

peak_power_w.note: 8 x 7.0 kW vendor max with active cables plus ~0.3 kW management; actual depends on populated switches

power_shelves.note: no 54 V power shelves; switch PSUs are fed by AC rack PDUs

liquid_fraction.note: basis is air-cooled Q3400-RA; use Q3450-LD for a liquid-cooled spine rack

max_coolant_supply_c.note: not applicable: air-cooled rack, no coolant loop

rack_pressure_drop_kpa.note: not applicable: air-cooled rack, no coolant loop

width_mm.note: standard 800 mm network cabinet width for side cable management

depth_mm.note: 1200 mm depth needed for 850 mm deep Q3400 plus rear cabling

weight_kg.note: 8 x 60 kg switches (vendor) + ~180 kg empty 48U 800x1200 cabinet + ~140 kg optics, cables, patch panels, PDUs

scale_out_ports.note: switch ports are modeled by the switch equipment placed in this rack

port_speed_gbps.note: XDR 800 Gb/s ports of the Q3400 basis

switch_slots.note: 8 x 4U Q3400-class switches in 48U leaves 16U for patch panels and management; ~16 2U 51.2 Tb/s switches also fit

sources.title: NVIDIA MMS4A00 1600Gb/s 2xDR4 twin-port OSFP single-mode transceiver (XDR, 500m)
NVIDIA Q32xx and Q34xx XDR 800Gb/s InfiniBand Switch Systems User Manual - Specifications
